verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows generic pipeline 'stages' (workable-docs-21) and a candidate rating/scorecard endpoint (workable-docs-13/25/34), but nothing documents a reusable 'interview plan' concept with per-stage question banks or per-interviewer focus areas defined once and reused. Missing for 10: documentation of structured interview kits/templates, question bank management, and per-interviewer scorecard assignment tied to a role.
